result.markdown:
For a small customer support team (roughly 2–10 agents), my top recommendation is **Freshdesk**\. It offers a good balance of affordability, ticket management, automation, and room to grow without the complexity of enterprise platforms.

However, there are a few excellent alternatives depending on how your team works.

## Top 5 help desk platforms for small teams

(Best overall)

From US\$19/agent/month, annual billing

- Excellent ticket management.
- Automated ticket assignment and workflows.
- Knowledge base and customer portal.
- AI-assisted support features.

Best for teams wanting a traditional, full-featured help desk at a reasonable price.

**2\. Help Scout**

(Best for simplicity)

Free plan; paid from US\$25/user/month

- Very clean, intuitive interface.
- Excellent shared email inbox.
- Collision detection so agents don't duplicate replies.
- Customer knowledge base.

Best for teams primarily handling customer inquiries through email.

[Help Scout website](https://www.helpscout.com/)

---

![Planning your knowledge base](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/c-aP08cOYxkyyv9X77vAO6BTznUrnbcE682O_PNXv85rTzeJ7P8rfPi0zwEy5RuJoItPtTqoOS_qx_th3WBRO5qW1_R1PEH6lnQv9fjQNK8k9Lq0ZpXaKAQ9c430TCrqKQIQ-l-YOuE_UJtZkcQj3vAw0fnqYwhILulvnKb-85lypWsGsBgNPmp7t1d2mt9a?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Zoho Desk**

(Best budget option)

Free for 3 agents; paid plans from US\$7/user/month

- Strong ticket tracking.
- Automation and workflow rules.
- Useful reporting and dashboards.
- Excellent Zoho ecosystem integration.

Best for smaller teams that want lots of functionality without spending much.

[Zoho Desk website](https://www.zoho.com/desk/)

---

![CXPA Global | CX Day](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/Df7ZME9U6OBHF5y7Iy8re15rfxWfkij2J5upWOY6h17xPwPTHy9GzGMO1pjPycv2eahYGXuZJQqpk7Eu-n45330bnP145JuZvq23mLa9ySgQfmrjrLanGhUx6oyklDReusakKYD0C0EVNYz4WHwYHTEn8t4EiNn2pI71GHk_6Pu88F0xspYAogvoagE-Nhjq?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Zendesk**

Entry-level support from US\$19/agent/month; Suite from US\$55

- Powerful ticketing and routing.
- Extensive integrations.
- Advanced reporting and SLAs.
- Excellent scalability.

Best for teams expecting significant growth or needing more sophisticated support processes.

| Freshdesk | Excellent | Excellent | Excellent | Very good |
| Help Scout | Excellent | Very good | Good | Good |
| Zoho Desk | Good | Excellent | Very good | Excellent |
| Zendesk | Good | Excellent | Excellent | Moderate |
| HubSpot | Excellent | Very good | Very good | Good |


## What I'd want in a small-team help desk

Regardless of which platform you choose, I'd prioritize\:

1. **Shared inbox\:** Everyone can see incoming customer requests.
2. **Ticket assignment\:** Every issue has an owner.
3. **Automation\:** Automatically categorize, assign and prioritize tickets.
4. **Internal notes\:** Agents can collaborate without customers seeing internal discussions.
5. **Reporting\:** Track response times, resolution times and ticket volume.
6. **Knowledge base\:** Customers can find answers themselves.
7. **SLA management\:** Make sure important customer requests aren't overlooked.
